cues: From ethanol it takes three steps.
Chlorine first oxidises ethanol to ethanal.
Then it replaces the three hydrogens of the methyl group, giving trichloroethanal, chloral.
Finally calcium hydroxide splits chloral into chloroform and calcium methanoate.
